sources.title: Fees Archives - Florida Board of Nursing
sources.notes: First real monitoring pilot (post-Phase 4.7). Watches the exact same page and field already backing Florida's real, verified rnEndorsementFeeUsd=$110 (Phase 2.5). The extraction pattern anchors to the 'MOBILE Endorsement Fees' heading specifically to avoid the page's other, coincidentally-identical $110.00 figure under 'Licensing by Exam Fees' (a different, unrelated fee type) and the $100.00 under 'Multi-state Upgrade Fees' (which appears earlier on the page). Live-fetch confirmed against the real page on 2026-08-09 before this fixture/rule was written.
